# Canada Safety Council

> Canada Safety Council provides evidence-based safety education and prevention resources across fraud, cybersecurity, home security, and community safety.

The Canada Safety Council is a national organization dedicated to injury prevention and safety awareness. Their content addresses critical issues including senior fraud prevention, home security, crime prevention, and seasonal safety risks, partnering with organizations like the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre and Statistics Canada.

## Key Topics

- senior-safety
- fraud-prevention
- scam-awareness
- cybersecurity
- home-security
- crime-prevention
- elder-abuse
- romance-scams
- break-in-prevention
- community-safety
- social-isolation
- winter-safety
- national-safety-week
- seasonal-risks
- property-crime

## Senior Safety & Fraud Prevention

- [Staying Connected, Staying Safe](https://canadasafetycouncil.org/staying-connected-staying-safe): Senior fraud prevention guide during National Senior Safety Week

## Home Security & Crime Prevention

- [Safe Homes, Safe Communities](https://canadasafetycouncil.org/safe-homes-safe-communities): National Community Safety & Crime Prevention Month home security tips
